changes: ☁️ Tap-to-sync really syncs — clicking the 📴 pill now shows ⏳ Syncing…, pushes every queued change to Supabase, then ✅ All changes synced.
🧹 Stuck queues self-heal — writes rejected by the server (missing pin_hash/otp_list columns or RLS policy) are dropped with a visible ⚠️ reason instead of blocking the queue forever.
🛡️ Missing-config guard — if Supabase URL/key isn't set, the pill says so instead of silently re-queueing.
